go_out_of_box.name: SAME_SOURCE_ID_DIFFERENT_BYTES
go_out_of_box.description: In isolated local subprocesses, load the real local SQLite shared library and a temporary byte-altered copy, then compare sqlite3_libversion(), sqlite3_sourceid() and SHA-256.
go_out_of_box.interpretation: Version and source_id do not attest byte-for-byte loaded-library identity. This does not by itself show executable malicious substitution; it establishes an exact-artifact attestation gap.
